reason: Three spec_error items from round 2: wording stale against the standing launcher rule (production bugs first), an ambiguous 'Not launched' match, and a hardcoded note count that should derive from show --json.

changes.before: Expect no file in `$FX/wf` whose name contains `qr-gated-outputs`, `career-application-journey` or `global-change-standard`, and one whose name contains `release-scope`.
changes.after: Expect no file in `$FX/wf` whose name contains `career-application-journey` or `global-change-standard`, and one whose name contains `release-scope`. A file containing `qr-gated-outputs` exists only if stderr also has `Launched for their production bugs only:` naming qr-gated-outputs (it has open production bugs); any other backlog feature without open production bugs has no file.
changes.tracesTo: HANDOVER-0.3.0 Production bugs section; commit cbba5f7; release-loop-resume.mjs:82-85
changes.whyNeeded: The launcher's production-bug exception is a standing owner-approved rule (production bugs first, even for backlog features); the old wording fails whenever a backlog feature has an open production bug.

changes.before: Expect no "Not launched" line and a file whose name contains `qr-gated-outputs`.
changes.after: Expect no stderr line starting `Not launched (backlog,` and a file whose name contains `qr-gated-outputs`. (A `Not launched locally (validated on production)` line may appear.)
changes.whyNeeded: Removes the ambiguity with the unrelated production-validated line; the backlog-line check stays exact.

changes.before: In **Added after the cut**, expect four notes, each with `added 2026-10-10`: release-scope says `counted in this release`; the other three say `kept in backlog`. Each note ends with its reason.
changes.after: In **Added after the cut**, expect one note per `added` entry of `node scripts/release-scope.mjs show --json` (A of them), each with `added 2026-10-10`; a note whose entry has `scope` `planned` says `counted in this release` (C of them), the others say `kept in backlog`. Each note ends with its reason. At 2026-10-10T21:05Z these were 9 notes, 6 counted, 3 kept in backlog.
changes.tracesTo: A1 follow-up note; docs/changes/release-scope.md; commit de9b2f5
changes.whyNeeded: Counts must derive from the release file because the owner moves scope; fixed 'four' fails whenever scope changes.

checklist.Not weaker: pass: J3.1 still forbids the file unless the stated production-bug exception is evidenced on stderr; the old expectation contradicts the owner-approved rule that production bugs are launched first (commit cbba5f7, HANDOVER-0.3.0); J3.2 and J5.3 are equally strict (counts now tied to show --json)
checklist.Reachable: pass: cli steps and tracker notes walkable on desktop and 390px
checklist.Deterministic: pass: conditions are checked against stderr and show --json output; the dated figures are illustrative only

review.note: Checked against docs/changes/release-scope.md, release-loop-resume.mjs lines 82-85 and the round-2 results; all three are spec errors, product behaviour is correct.
